verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a first-party Audiences feature that builds audiences on warehouse sources and syncs or activates them downstream, so the core capability exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how audiences are built: no visual builder, no no-SQL claim, no trait/behavior conditions, and no size estimate before activation. missing for 10: evidence of a visual no-SQL audience builder, trait- and behavior-based conditions, estimated audience size before activation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audiences from traits and behavior in a visual builder — no SQL required — and see estimated size before activating
